Subject: ACME — follow-up & proposed next tests (function-calling / streaming / structured outputs)

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate the context on your inference needs and the latency/cost constraints for your customer-facing chat + tool orchestration flow. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you a tight apples-to-apples comparison vs the hyperscaler solution you prototyped: 

1) Recap of asks from today
- Validate function/tool-calling parity (we'll test Redwood's function calling shape + schema enforcement)
- Structured outputs: ensure deterministic JSON output for invoice extraction and metadata fields
- Streaming: test long-session streaming with partial results and mid-stream tool calls
- Latency/throughput SLOs: target 150ms p95 for short responses, sustainable throughput at 200 concurrent sessions

2) What I will provide by tomorrow
- Feature parity matrix (attached) that maps Redwood features to the hyperscaler endpoints you tested
- A proposed test plan with example prompts and sample transcript format
- Test harness instructions so your team can run local runs or we can run them from our dedicated pool

3) What I need from you
- A redacted sample of typical chat transcripts for streaming tests (few representative long sessions)
- The desired structured output schema for invoice extraction (small JSON schema)

If that all looks right I’ll loop in Rishi (SE) and Stephanie (sales ops) to schedule the tests and allocate a dedicated run on our staging pool. Looking at availability — can we target to start tests on Wednesday 7/21?

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Re: ACME — follow-up & proposed next tests (function-calling / streaming / structured outputs)

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side before we kick off tests: 

- For function-calling: we need the Redwood calls to support nested tool calls (tool A returns a URL which we then call tool B) and preserve call metadata in the conversation history. Can you confirm if your function-calling model can reproduce the same call/response shape?
- Structured outputs: our main use case is invoice extraction (line items, totals, tax breakdown). See attached sample schema and a redacted payload (acme-streaming-sample-transcripts.jsonl) — please confirm whether Redwood can deliver a consistent JSON output for these examples.
- Streaming: priority is being able to stream partial results while the model is still generating and to interleave tool calls mid-stream. Also need p95 latency for short responses to be close to 150ms.

We can start the tests on 7/21 as you suggested. Also please include an estimated runtime and who on your side will own the test harness so we can coordinate access.

Joe
Joe Simmons | Director, Product (Conversations)
Acme, Inc.
joe.simmons@acme.com
